spans.text: - paragraph: You have spider mites!! They like to hide under the leaves and suck the chlorophyll from your plant. You may find webbing and tiny mites- if so, you need to quarantine that palm (and wash your hands/change your clothes) before handling your other plants, because they WILL infest everywhere. After you move that plant off to the side you should start by thoroughly washing each fronds front and back with water, a touch of dawn dish soap, and a few drops of ultrafine oil. Make sure to rinse well afterwards so the leaves don't burn in the sun.

- paragraph: You're welcome! Spider mites are a nightmare to deal with once they become problematic like this. In the future make sure to check leaves and stem regularly for signs of pests so you can take care of them before they get out of hand 👍
